# Manual testing to automatic testing

> A formal training programme that upskills manual testers at Bands 3 to 7 into automatic testers, over 308 hours of protected learning time ending with a Lean Six Sigma Green Belt (lifetime certification), while each person stays in the band and UK GDaD PCF role they already hold. Eight tuned tracks share one schedule. Every gate repeats a full capability self-assessment: the band (21 dimensions: 5 band outline dimensions and 16 job evaluation factors), the UK GDaD PCF role aspects, and every skill in the role. Pass marks rise from 60% at Gate 1 to 90% at Gate 4.

## Pages

- [Programme specification](https://manual-testing-to-automatic-testing.github.io/en-001/spec/): the single source of truth
- [Curriculum](https://manual-testing-to-automatic-testing.github.io/en-001/curriculum/): learning outcomes, schedule, modules, and gates, in one place
- [Mentor](https://manual-testing-to-automatic-testing.github.io/en-001/mentor/): what a mentor does, why, and the time it takes
- [Line manager](https://manual-testing-to-automatic-testing.github.io/en-001/manager/): what a line manager does, why, and the time it takes
- [Plan](https://manual-testing-to-automatic-testing.github.io/en-001/plan/): why the programme is shaped this way
- [Tasks](https://manual-testing-to-automatic-testing.github.io/en-001/tasks/): the work to build and run it
- [Tracks](https://manual-testing-to-automatic-testing.github.io/en-001/tracks/): one page per band and role, with its guide and its capability self-assessment, scored in the browser
- [Modules](https://manual-testing-to-automatic-testing.github.io/en-001/modules/): Modules 1 to 17
- [Lean Six Sigma Green Belt](https://manual-testing-to-automatic-testing.github.io/en-001/module-17-lean-six-sigma-green-belt/): Module 17, 40 hours, the last module on every track
- [Gates](https://manual-testing-to-automatic-testing.github.io/en-001/gates/): thresholds, practicals, forms
